scope: PickCube initial A/B/C development, fixed before learned SAC results
B: fixed-final BC mean initialized; fresh stochastic variance; online replay only
C: same initialization as B; 50 percent shared audited expert training-episode transitions per update
rationale: First finite full development run: 262144 real interactions and approximately 64528 updates; no convergence claim. Measure wall time before expanding seeds. Batch/UTD are held common across A/B/C and are explicit deviations from upstream UTD=.5.
